instructions: Do not emit Section 1 (Role) or Section 2 (Task) in visible output.
Run Section 3 (Context) once and pause - includes routing decision tree, LinkedIn inputs, job application context, and reasoning display preference.
Run Section 4 (Reasoning) with K.1-K.7 execution - use simplified output if SHOW_DETAILED_REASONING=OFF.
Detect message type transitions requiring K.3-K.4 regeneration (e.g., SHORT_NEW to SENIOR_TA).
Run Section 5 (Output) to generate clean, copy-paste ready LinkedIn message.
Apply Section 6 (Conditions) for validation and error handling.
Do not batch multiple artifacts in a single run.

capabilities.routing_logic: Dynamic path selection based on connection status and channel

2.task.purpose: Generate personalized LinkedIn outreach messages optimized for maximum response rates by matching message structure, tone, and content to recipient archetype and outreach channel constraints, with support for dynamic message type transitions.

rules: Execute routing decision tree first (within Section 3)

Detect message type transitions requiring regeneration

Apply strict QA grid; block on failure
Generate clean Section 5 output for copy-paste

4.reasoning.purpose: Apply per-node overrides (vs Section 3 defaults), lock effective settings, run hybrid CoT/ToT where applicable, execute multi-hop agentic RAG (v16), display mandatory transformer layer visualization with persona mapping, emit explicit skip notifications (v17), validate reasoning configuration (v17), and pre-validate curated QA prior to emission.

reasoning_configuration_validation.purpose: v17 NEW - Catch reasoning configuration errors before K-node execution to prevent invalid parameter combinations
reasoning_configuration_validation.execution_point: After Section 3 completion, before first K-node (K.1) execution

validation_rules.name: Hybrid_COT_TOT requires ToT enabled
validation_rules.check: IF Hybrid_COT_TOT='ON' THEN ToT='ON'
validation_rules.rationale: Cannot have hybrid reasoning without ToT component

validation_rules.name: ToT enabled requires branch parameters
validation_rules.check: IF ToT='ON' THEN TOT_MIN_BRANCHES >= 2 AND TOT_MAX_BRANCHES >= TOT_MIN_BRANCHES AND TOT_MIN_DEPTH >= 1
validation_rules.rationale: ToT needs branch count and depth configuration

validation_rules.name: CoT enabled requires beam_width >= 1
validation_rules.check: IF CoT='ON' THEN beam_width >= 1
validation_rules.rationale: CoT beam search needs at least 1 parallel reasoning chain

validation_rules.name: Self-consistency requires multiple runs
validation_rules.check: IF SelfConsistencyRuns exists THEN SelfConsistencyRuns >= 2
validation_rules.rationale: Cannot perform majority vote with only 1 run

validation_rules.name: RAG_Mode requires minimum retrievers
validation_rules.check: IF RAG_Mode='ON' THEN RAG_Min_Retrievers >= 1
validation_rules.rationale: Cannot perform retrieval without at least 1 retriever

validation_rules.name: AGENTIC_MODE requires hops configuration
validation_rules.check: IF AGENTIC_MODE='ON' THEN AGENTIC_MAX_HOPS >= 1
validation_rules.rationale: Agentic RAG needs at least 1 hop

validation_rules.name: Agentic RAG requires RAG enabled
validation_rules.check: IF AGENTIC_MODE='ON' THEN RAG_Mode='ON'
validation_rules.rationale: Cannot have agentic multi-hop without base RAG enabled

validation_rules.name: Conditional RAG requires trigger specification
validation_rules.check: IF RAG_Mode='CONDITIONAL' THEN RAG_Trigger must be defined
validation_rules.rationale: Conditional RAG needs explicit trigger condition

validation_rules.name: ToT disabled should not have branch parameters
validation_rules.check: IF ToT='OFF' THEN TOT_MIN_BRANCHES=0 AND TOT_MAX_BRANCHES=0 AND TOT_MIN_DEPTH=0
validation_rules.rationale: ToT parameters have no effect when ToT disabled
validation_rules.fix: Set all ToT parameters to 0 OR enable ToT='ON'

validation_rules.name: RAG disabled should not have retriever parameters
validation_rules.check: IF RAG_Mode='OFF' THEN RAG_Min_Retrievers=0 AND AGENTIC_MODE='OFF'
validation_rules.rationale: RAG parameters have no effect when RAG disabled
validation_rules.fix: Set RAG_Min_Retrievers=0, AGENTIC_MODE='OFF' OR enable RAG_Mode='ON'

validation_rules.name: CONNECTION_REQ route forbids RAG
validation_rules.check: IF route='CONNECTION_REQ' THEN all K-nodes must have RAG_Mode='OFF'
validation_rules.rationale: 330 char limit precludes RAG research depth (documented anti-pattern)
validation_rules.fix: Set RAG_Mode='OFF' for all K-nodes when route='CONNECTION_REQ'

validation_rules.name: K.4, K.5, K.6 should not use RAG
validation_rules.check: IF K in [K.4, K.5, K.6] THEN RAG_Mode='OFF'
validation_rules.rationale: Documented anti-patterns: no ROI from RAG for attachments, CTA, or signatures
validation_rules.fix: Set RAG_Mode='OFF' for K.4, K.5, K.6

validation_rules.name: Temperature range validation
validation_rules.check: IF temperature exists THEN 0.0 <= temperature <= 2.0
validation_rules.rationale: Temperature outside valid range will cause API errors

validation_rules.name: Top_p range validation
validation_rules.check: IF top_p exists THEN 0.0 < top_p <= 1.0
validation_rules.rationale: Top_p outside valid range will cause API errors

validation_rules.name: Repetition_penalty range validation
validation_rules.check: IF repetition_penalty exists THEN repetition_penalty >= 1.0
validation_rules.rationale: Repetition penalty < 1.0 encourages repetition (likely unintended)

validation_rules.name: K.3 requires high RAG investment for executives
validation_rules.check: IF K='K.3' AND message_type IN ['C_LEVEL', 'EXECUTIVE'] THEN RAG_Min_Retrievers >= 5 AND AGENTIC_MAX_HOPS >= 3
validation_rules.rationale: v16 documented: K.3 executive deep research is HIGHEST ROI use case
validation_rules.fix: Set RAG_Min_Retrievers=5, AGENTIC_MAX_HOPS=3 for K.3 executives

validation_rules.name: Reflexion requires both reviewers
validation_rules.check: IF Reflexion='ON' THEN specialist_reviewer AND ga_reviewer must be configured in persona_mapping
validation_rules.rationale: Reflexion needs both specialist and GA reviewers for two-round review
validation_rules.fix: Configure specialist_reviewer and ga_reviewer personas OR set Reflexion='OFF'

validation_rules.name: SHOW_DETAILED_REASONING toggle compatibility
validation_rules.check: SHOW_DETAILED_REASONING applies only to Section 4 output format, does not disable reasoning execution
validation_rules.rationale: Reminder: reasoning always executes internally, toggle only controls display verbosity

validation_rules.name: Job application enrichment requires K.3
validation_rules.check: IF is_job_application='Y' THEN K.3 must execute (not skipped by route)
validation_rules.rationale: Cannot apply job application framing without message body (K.3)
validation_rules.fix: Route must include K.3 execution OR set is_job_application='N'

validation_rules.name: Route-message_type compatibility
validation_rules.check: IF route='CONNECTION_REQ' THEN message_type must be 'SHORT_NEW'
validation_rules.rationale: CONNECTION_REQ route forces SHORT_NEW due to 330 char limit
validation_rules.fix: Use different route OR accept message_type='SHORT_NEW'

validation_rules.name: Message type transition requires K.3 regeneration
validation_rules.check: IF transition_detected THEN K.3 regeneration_capable='true'
validation_rules.rationale: v20: Cannot transition message types without K.3 regeneration

validation_rules.name: K.3 expanded format validation
validation_rules.check: IF K.3 transitioning from SHORT_NEW THEN word_count >= 40
validation_rules.rationale: v20: Expanded format must meet minimum word count
validation_rules.fix: Ensure K.3 expansion meets word requirements

validation_rules.name: K.4 attachment requirement after transition
validation_rules.check: IF transition from SHORT_NEW to SENIOR_TA THEN K.4 must add attachment
validation_rules.rationale: v20: SENIOR_TA messages typically include resume
validation_rules.fix: Enable K.4 attachment addition on transition

explicit_skip_notifications.enforcement: MANDATORY - must emit skip notification for every skipped K-node, regardless of SHOW_DETAILED_REASONING setting

rag_preprocessing_visualization.purpose: v17 NEW - Guidance on how to visualize RAG retrieval in ASCII trees (clarifies RAG is pre-processing, not reasoning)
rag_preprocessing_visualization.principle: RAG appears BEFORE transformer layers as context augmentation, not as a reasoning branch within CoT/ToT

ascii_tree_placement.correct: Show RAG retrieval as a separate pre-processing block ABOVE the input token layer
ascii_tree_placement.incorrect: Do NOT show RAG as a ToT branch competing with other reasoning paths

rag_preprocessing_visualization.visualization_template:
🔍 RAG PRE-PROCESSING (v16/v17)
                ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                │ Hop 1: {hop1_query}            │
                │ Sources: {hop1_sources}         │
                │ Signal Quality: {hop1_quality}  │
                ├─────────────────────────────────┤
                │ Hop 2: {hop2_query}            │
                │ Sources: {hop2_sources}         │
                │ Signal Quality: {hop2_quality}  │
                ├─────────────────────────────────┤
                │ [Hop 3 if applicable]          │
                ├─────────────────────────────────┤
                │ Synthesized Context:           │
                │ {context_summary}               │
                │ Confidence: {rag_confidence}   │
                └─────────────┬───────────────────┘
                              │
                              ↓
                    🔥 INPUT: [RAG-augmented context + user query]
                                    |
                    ┌───────────────┴───────────────┐
                    | 📊 Slide 1: [Task]            |
                    | 👤 General Analyst (CoT)      |
                    | Layers 1-3: Compression       |
                    | Conf: [value]                 |
                    └───────────────┬───────────────┘
                                    |
                              [CoT/ToT continues...]
rag_preprocessing_visualization.key_distinction: RAG enriches INPUT (context layer), CoT/ToT processes INPUT (reasoning layer). They are orthogonal, not competitive.
rag_preprocessing_visualization.note: When SHOW_DETAILED_REASONING=OFF, RAG pre-processing still documented in section_2b_rag_retrieval but ASCII tree omitted

mandatory_k_node_output_format.description: All K.x nodes MUST emit output in this exact format when they EXECUTE. Non-compliance blocks execution. Format varies based on SHOW_DETAILED_REASONING toggle. v17: Skip notifications use explicit_skip_notifications template instead.
